core_obligations: Setup and reduction (proof lines 5521-5543): by the represent-homotopy lemma the chain homotopy data {N_n} is represented by a morphism diamond N(U) -> N(V); it suffices to build psi : N(U x Delta[1]) -> diamond N(U) with diamond a = psi N(e_0), diamond b = psi N(e_1), carrying the canonical homotopy of N(e_0), N(e_1) (id on U x Delta[1]) to diamond h; since N is a direct summand of s and diamond is compatible with direct sums, it suffices to construct Psi : s(U x Delta[1]) -> diamond s(U) with the corresponding properties.

Construction of Psi (lines 5545-5581): e_0 and e_1 are homotopic with homotopy id; lemma-homotopy-s-N gives the explicit h_n with h_{n-1} = sum (-1)^{i+1} s^n_i alpha^n_{i+1}; the map-into-diamond lemma converts it into Phi : diamond s(U) -> s(U x Delta[1]); the cokernel W of (e_0, e_1) : U + U -> U x Delta[1] has W_n = the sum of U_n alpha^n_i for i = 1..n; the splittings sigma_n send U_n alpha^n_i via (-1, 1) to U_n alpha^n_0 + U_n alpha^n_i; s(pi) sigma = 0 forces (1,1) delta(sigma) = 0, so delta(sigma) factors as in the map-into-diamond lemma, yielding Psi : s(U x Delta[1]) -> diamond s(U).

Computation of delta(sigma) (lines 5584-5677): by the termwise-split lemma one computes d sigma - sigma d on W_n; the computation is carried out with elements in the category of abelian groups (see notes): d(x_alpha) expands over the face maps, sigma subtracts the alpha^n_0 component, and after cancelling, the only surviving term is on the summand U_n alpha^n_n, where delta(sigma)_n = ((-1)^n d^n_n, -(-1)^n d^n_n) (the alpha^{n-1}_0 terms drop because alpha^n_j circ delta^n_i = alpha^{n-1}_n forces j = n, i = n).

Psi is the desired map (lines 5679-5717): in the canonical 3x3 diagram of the two termwise-split sequences, it suffices to check that Phi composed with delta(sigma) acts as the identity on the first factor and minus the identity on the second of s(U)[-1] + s(U)[-1]; by the computation this is ((-1)^n d^n_0, -(-1)^n d^n_0) circ (-1)^n s^n_n = (1, -1); hence Psi reproduces the homotopy and the lemma follows from the reduction.
proof_roadmap: Reduce from N to s using the direct-summand structure of N and direct-sum compatibility of the diamond functor.
Build Psi through the map-into-diamond factorization with the explicit (-1, 1) splittings sigma_n.
Compute delta(sigma) = d sigma - sigma d summand-wise; only the alpha^n_n summand survives.
Check Phi after delta(sigma) is (1, -1) and conclude via the reduction.
difficulty_reason: Homotopy-lifting lemma (statement 5506-5519, proof 5521-5717): reduces from the normalized complex to the direct-sum complex functor, constructs Psi through the map-into-diamond factorization with explicit splittings, computes delta(sigma) by a complete element calculation in which every cancelling term is displayed and the unique survivor identified, and verifies the composition is (1, -1); no verification is left unexpanded. H3: 197-line proof with a full summand-wise computation.
